design_spec.layout: Hero 16:9 with preserved Dragon Bridge subject; Campus Dock; five ecosystem tabs; 6/9/12 initial cards mobile/tablet/desktop; useful tools reachable by top navigation; append pagination.
design_spec.responsive: <768 one-column deals, 768–1023 two columns, >=1024 three columns; 16/24/32px outer gutters. Dock scrolls inside its own row; no page overflow.
design_spec.cards: Media target 60%, explicit dimensions; title <=2 lines, price and basis, sourced savings if available, two numbered redemption CTAs and compact invite. Full conditions in drawer. Text zoom may grow card height.
design_spec.media: No evidence screenshots as marketing photography; no unrelated fallback. Store source URL, rights basis, SHA256, entity/category binding, dimensions, alt and focal point. Missing media uses relevant neutral illustration with visible label.
design_spec.states: Skeleton preserves geometry; hover lifts <=2px; pressed/focus visible; copy success 2s, clipboard denial exposes selectable text; empty 'Chưa có ưu đãi phù hợp' with reset; unavailable destination disables purchase and explains briefly.
design_spec.drawer: Desktop max560px; mobile max90dvh bottom sheet. Focus entry/trap/Escape/return and Back/deep-link handling. Terms scroll independently.
design_spec.accessibility: AA contrast in both themes, 44px targets, keyboard tabs/dock/slider, input labels, aria-live result counts, 200% zoom and reduced motion. Emerald highlight includes text so color is not sole indicator.
